scenes.heading: Video from JSON
scenes.sub: Describe the scenes. The engine draws and times them.
scenes.say: Scenefile turns a short JSON file into a finished video.

scenes.text: Models can say what a video should show. Drawing it is the hard part.
scenes.highlight: Drawing it is the hard part.
scenes.say: A language model can say what a video should show. Drawing it correctly is the hard part.
So scenefile does the drawing. Check finds problems and says how to fix them. Render writes the video.

scenes.heading: What you get
items: A voice made on your machine
Errors that say how to fix them
scenes.say: You get eleven kinds of scene, a voice made on your own machine, and errors that come with their fix.

scenes.heading: Write JSON. Get a video.
scenes.say: Install it with npm, write some JSON, and get a video.
